To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a reliable real time nested transaction scheduling model for a single processor can be implemented with the Real Time Nested Transaction Priority Ceiling Protocol, which guarantees timing constraints of real time transactions, maintains the ACID properties, and prevents unbounded blocking, deadlock, and nonserializability.

the Real Time Priority Ceiling Protocol, extended to support the nested transaction model, is an efficient and reliable algorithm that guarantees the real time requirements of a set of transactions and maintains consistency in a single processor environment.
a real time nested priority ceiling protocol is proposed to schedule a set of real time nested transactions on a single processor system.

the development of a reliable real time nested transaction protocol for a single processor environment.
the design, implementation, and verification of a real-time nested transaction model for a single processor environment.
the development of a reliable nested transaction model and an efficient real time scheduling protocol for a single processor system.

the Real Time Nesting Priority Ceiling Protocol is the first integrated concurrency control and schedulability algorithm for real time nested transaction that guarantees timing constraints and maintains consistency of a set of transactions.
the RTNP protocol provides an efficient and effective solution to the problem of scheduling hard real time transactions on a single processor system.
the proposed model provides an efficient and effective way for the development of real time systems.

the proposed algorithm is a practical and effective solution for the scheduling and concurrency control of hard real time nested transactions.

the real time nested transactions model is an effective model for the development of real time systems, and the real time nested priority ceiling protocol is a practical and efficient algorithm for the real time nested transaction scheduling problem.
